notes: Initial prototype of the BJJ Evolution Dashboard per the iteration 8 PRD. Mocked data simulating a 30-day window of BJJ training: techniques, technique category breakdown, role balance, roll outcomes, and position flow transitions. All UI strings in English (aligned with prd-bjj-dashboard.md v0.3). No live source connected; refresh re-runs against the inlined data only.
transformations: Computed donut SVG dasharray/dashoffset for 7 technique categories at a 50px radius (C=2*pi*50).
Mapped role balance to a stacked horizontal bar with per-row mini progress bars.
Mapped roll outcomes to 4 colored tiles with mini progress fills.
Mapped roll flow to 7 transition edges with widths proportional to count (max=24 -> 100%).
